questions.question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is brother of B’

If D + E + F – G × H ÷ I – J, then which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: E is the daughter of G

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Mother

 
 Brother
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : D + E + F – G × H ÷ I – J

So,

 
• D + E → D is the daughter of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd7111e155bce4d6efe8cef6bfc36ef0e84806897fb0dd32a2a73897a74f32b.png] 

 
• E + F → E is the daughter of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79cffb8ab319df62f18358d60616ec526aedd541598f18ff8776113c9f63eba7.png] 

 
• F – G → F is the husband of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a7ee14e3c5d1406f339a8dcbdb2850a9e78f9356c2bed37c1d7439f01ff2513.png] 

 
• G × H → G is the mother of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5afa2c813df5d75b0c892a71eab882539308d1861957d554d85a84befc594f.png] 

 
• H ÷ I → H is the brother of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8cf2d33974d1ccb877bfca41b341b9b309e0f1a921ba47401fd95eff8573180.png] 

 
• I – J → I is the husband of J.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ae684de31507561be6188044b8292afd580d59c022c1b57d865baaac332c41f.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : D is sister of I → **Incorrect statement** ⇒ D is niece of I
 
• Option - (2) : E is sister of I → Correct statement
 
• Option - (3) : E is sister of H → Correct statement
 
• Option - (4) : E is the daughter of G → Correct statement

Hence, "**Option - (1)**" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements?

**Statement:**

All cows are mammals.

All donkeys are mammals.

All mammals are animals.

**Conclusion:**

I. All donkeys are animals.

II. All animals are donkeys.

III. Some cows are donkeys.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8229f10e2e88d86f47c8f4c1929f41a47d4f992b94bb64d72d53b6a21094fed9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All donkeys are animals → Follow (As all donkeys are mammals and all mammals are animals. So, as all donkeys comes in mammals which all comes in animals therefore all donkeys are animals is definitely true)

II. All animals are donkeys → **Does not **follow (As all donkeys are mammals and all mammals are animals. So, Some animals are definitely donkeys but All animals are donkeys can be possible only)

III. Some cows are donkeys → Does not follow (No definite relation given between cows and donkeys. So, it can be possible only)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows .

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".

questions.question:
Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting next to each other in a straight line facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). U is sitting immediate left of V. R sits fifth to the left of V. R is sitting immediately adjacent to P and T. S sits third to the right of R.

Who is sitting immediate right of Q?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting next to each other in a straight line facing north

**Explanation :**

1) R sits fifth to the left of V.

2) S sits third to the right of R.

As position of V is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for V.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa7c862d3acaae2827131b1fa8e5dc60c41e5a7930bd9a48653f038b12d27a20.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd8154e650200896e6686984e09b09fc046cd837a5cd72ff16ebf7f79dd51c1c.png] 

3) U is sitting immediate left of V.

4) R is sitting immediately adjacent to P and T.

As R is an immediate neighbor of P and T, therefore case - (1) is eliminated.

As position of P and T with respect to R is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for P and T.

After positioning P, T and U only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Q.

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0d1770f5a5e666c98efdd3df959c43b5818a5a4a86e38d588f9a580a933f7a2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement S is sitting immediate right of Q.

Hence, **"S"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Eight persons – D, E, G, H, K, L, S and T are sitting in a straight line facing north. E sits second from the left end of the row. No one is sitting between H and E. G sits fourth to the right of H. K is sitting immediate left of G. Only two persons sit between K and D. L is sitting third to the right of S. How many persons are sitting between S and T?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Eight persons – D, E, G, H, K, L, S and T are sitting in a straight line facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) E sits second from the left end of the row.

2) No one is sitting between H and E.

As position of E with respect to E is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for H.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acb97ee40b04684a4ad9946b2d0aafebf4ac27f4344c60afe40952c27a5f845f.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e60bfe26f43065d87d63dc84e079c101a584aeaa62d3c998a58ef9b4688892bc.png] 

3) G sits fourth to the right of H.

4) K is sitting immediate left of G.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7045b2610bf2cd5dcd23cef480a4a88525481eee6e43d3773a28dc87be250c11.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93d796c1bce1bfe5d2e005f9b047eef75e48e7400079652162a464ef414e984f.png] 

5) Only two persons sit between K and D.

6) L is sitting third to the right of S.

As there is possible position for D is case - (2), therefore case - (2) is eliminated.

After positioning D, L and S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T.

 
• Case - (1) :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e572dbbacffec6d30623da44ecdee815cc2c4cdd2052c911361f16f641ebbbd2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement four people i.e K, G, L and D are sitting between S and T.

Hence, "**More than three**" is the correct answer.
